subject: Personalized snippet triggers + link fingerprinting for inbound webinar
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Personalization snippets + link fingerprinting for next inbound webinar

Team —

Quick kickoff for the August 28 webinar (Serving LLMs at scale: real SLOs and cost levers). A few constraints from last quarter: registration-to-attend conversion ticked down ~6% for developer audiences when links were long and generic. I want us to test two things for this inbound invite series:

1) Personalized snippet triggers in the email body (one-line developer-focused snippet based on persona tag). We should swap the hero sentence per segment (e.g., "Reduce per-token bill by 40% with batching heuristics" for infra engs).

2) Link fingerprinting for tracking: unique UTM+fingerprint per recipient so we can map which snippet drove clicks and downstream join rates without relying only on cookies. That will let us pass a stable id to the registration page and attribute opens->clicks->joins more accurately.

Deliverables by EOD Thu:
- Karthik: segment definitions + 3 snippet variants per segment (developer, infra/platform, data). CSV attached as initial draft.
- Connor: short spec for link fingerprinting (query param pattern + safe hashing approach) and a sample redirect URL we can hand to the registration page.
- Laura: send cadence (touch windows, micro-reminders, local-time delivery) and a draft reminder schedule PDF.

Please reference the attached CSV and the UTM matrix skeleton in Drive when replying. Top priority is making a small, measurable change we can A/B on next run.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

Attachments: snippet-triggers-v1.csv, utm-fingerprint-matrix.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Personalization snippets + link fingerprinting for next inbound webinar

Marissa —

Thanks, this looks good. I ran the existing audience exports against last quarter and propose three priority segments:
- "Platform Engineers" (high KV cache interest, slow median latency pain)
- "Product/Data" (embedding/rerank use cases, cost per-call sensitivity)
- "Dev Tools/Integration" (SDK/ops-focused, care about onboarding friction)

Attached CSV has 3 snippet variants per segment (short [hero], midline supportive bullet, 1-line social proof). Example hero for Platform Engineers: "Slash tail-latency with smart KV cache warms — see a 2x latency tail improvement in 70% of tests."

For UTM/fingerprint: I propose we append ftid=<sha1(email+env+campaign)> and use utm_medium=email, utm_campaign=2025_08_webinar_inbound, utm_content=segment_snippet_id. That will give us per-recipient, per-snippet attribution without exposing PII if we hash correctly. I'm attaching the utm-fingerprint-matrix.xlsx to the Drive link and the csv here.

Open question: how granular do we want per-variant sending windows? I recommend two send windows (AM and PM local) + micro-reminders at 72h, 24h, and 2h before the event. Laura — if you can map those to local-time ranges (US/PST, US/EST) that'd be great.

-Karthik

Attachments: snippet-triggers-v1.csv, utm-fingerprint-matrix.xlsx

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2025 10:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Personalization snippets + link fingerprinting for next inbound webinar

All —

I sketched a minimal link-fingerprinting flow that won't require backend changes to the registration page (we'll issue a redirect link that emits the ftid param and then forwards to the same registration form). Spec highlights:
- Redirect host: reg.redwood.com/r (one-line serverless redirect)
- Query params: ftid=<sha1(email+campaign_salt)>, utm_campaign, utm_source=email, utm_content=snippet_id
- The redirect stores a short mapping (ftid -> [initial referral metadata]) in our ephemeral cache for 7 days, then forwards to the canonical registration page + normal form submission.

Security note: use a campaign-specific salt and rotate monthly; don't log raw emails. Using SHA-1 is OK for non-PII mapping here (we're not storing email in cleartext). I'll drop a one-page spec into Drive.

Draft sample link (example only):
https://reg.redwood.com/r?ftid=sha1abc123&utm_campaign=2025_08_webinar_inbound&utm_content=platform_hero

I also built a small test harness that will generate redirect URLs for a sample seed of 500 recipients so we can validate click-to-register attribution before we send. Want me to run that against the Acme Logistics seed?

-Connor

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Avery Cloud <avery@averycloud.com>, Event Partnerships <eventbrite-partner@eventbrite.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Aug 2025 15:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Personalization snippets + link fingerprinting for next inbound webinar

Thanks all — fast and clear. Quick notes and next steps before we finalize copy:

- Karthik: your snippets look strong. Please reduce the social proof line to 70 chars for the mobile variant.
- Connor: yes, run the harness on Acme's seed (Sam Turner) and drop the sample report into Drive by EOD Fri. Make sure the ftid mapping contains only hashed values.
- Laura: please finalize the staggered reminder schedule (attached PDF) and confirm local-time windows for US/PST and US/EST. We'll default EMEA/APAC to single global sends for this run.

I'll loop in Partnerships to confirm the registration redirect host is acceptable for Eventbrite channel shares. Avery/Sam — can you confirm if Acme prefers AM local sends or PM? Sam, a one-line reply is fine. If we get a preference we can override their segment-level default.

Action items:
- Karthik: mobile snippet trim (due: Thu EOD)
- Connor: harness run + sample ftid report (due: Fri EOD)
- Laura: finalize schedule PDF (done in attached)

I'll schedule a 30-minute sync Thu 09:30 PT to finalize.

Best,
Marissa
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

Attachments: staggered-reminder-schedule.pdf
